info.name: GET a list of all scans in the past 90 days for the application id given in the request

params.name: page
params.description: Parameter to specify the page number of the records to retrieve

params.name: size
params.description: parameter to specify the number of records to retrieve per page

params.name: sort
params.description: parameter to specify the sort parameter and direction

items.docs: The data is returned in pages. Multiple API calls have to be made to return the complete list.

info.name: Run an organization scan for the specified application

params.name: orgScanOnly
params.description: If this parameter is set to true, only organization scan runs for Azure and GCP (Environment scan is not triggered.) The default value when this query parameter is not passed is false.
